incentive_metrics.quote: Also, as part of the Company’s program to deliver outsized awards to top performers, Kunal recommended and the Compensation Committee approved an individual performance adjustment for Danny, and that a portion of the adjustment be delivered in restricted stock units that vest 18 months after the grant date.

notable_language.quote: In 2022, we modified our equity program to provide a higher mix of performance-based compensation as compared with 2021. For executive officers, the mix of annual equity grant changed from 50% Market Stock Units / 50% Restricted Stock Units to 75% Market Stock Units / 25% Restricted Stock Units.
notable_language.why_notable: Explicit statement of the year's key design change, shifting the equity mix toward performance-based awards.

notable_language.quote: We conduct a robust goal setting process and our performance in 2022 was below our target goals for Adjusted Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA
notable_language.why_notable: Unusually direct admission of missing both annual financial targets, paired with a defence of the goal-setting process.

notable_language.quote: Does not use rigid formulas to determine executive compensation but nevertheless aims to tie annual cash incentive compensation closely to value creation, as measured by increases in Adjusted Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA or similar measures.
notable_language.why_notable: Recurring philosophy language preserving committee discretion while claiming formulaic alignment.

notable_language.quote: When the financial and strategic performance measures were established, and consistent with prior years, the Committee determined that these adjustments, and other significant charges not included in the Company’s internal 2022 budget should be excluded from both the establishment of goals as well as the determination of payout calculations to more closely align with the underlying operating performance of the business.
notable_language.why_notable: Justification for a broad set of non-GAAP exclusions that affect both goal setting and payout, framed as consistency with prior years.

notable_language.quote: His salary was not changed in 2022 and remains at $500,000, the lowest in the peer group. His target bonus was increased from $1,000,000 to $1,500,000 and the target annual equity award was increased from $2,000,000 to $3,500,000.
notable_language.why_notable: Committee justifies a large increase in CEO variable pay by benchmarking to peer percentiles while emphasising an unchanged low salary.

notable_language.quote: The Company fell short of its financial targets but navigated relatively well through difficult credit and equity markets in the second half of 2022.
notable_language.why_notable: Qualitative framing of the shortfall used in support of a 100% individual performance factor for the CEO.

notable_language.quote: Given the significant shareholder support, the Compensation Committee did not make any changes to the Company’s executive compensation program in response to the 2022 say on pay vote.
notable_language.why_notable: Uses the 98% say-on-pay result to justify no responsive changes.

notable_language.quote: Our Total Shareholder Return, which is measured over a three-year time frame on an absolute basis, far exceeded the target goals in our long-term Market Stock Unit plan.
notable_language.why_notable: Highlights the absolute (not relative) TSR basis, which produced above-maximum payouts in a year when one-year TSR was -36.3%.

notable_language.quote: We do not have any employment agreements or change-in-control agreements with any of our executive officers.
notable_language.why_notable: Recurring governance claim about the absence of contractual severance protections.
